description: Hierarchical position of the event record.
condition: Required for every record.
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: L1 is a parent event; L2 is nested within L1; L3 is nested within L2. Use L1 records for national totals to avoid double counting nested records.

description: Unique identifier encoding the event hierarchy.
condition: Required for every record.
allowed_values: L1: YYYY-NNN; L2: YYYY-NNN-SS; L3: YYYY-NNN-SS-GG
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: YYYY equals Start year. NNN, SS and GG are zero-padded sequence numbers. Removing the final two-digit suffix yields the parent ID for L2 and L3.

description: Year when direct flood impacts began.
condition: Required for every record.
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: Calendar year; also encoded in Event ID.

description: Month when direct flood impacts began.
condition: Required for every record.
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: A missing day does not imply the first day of the month.

description: Day of the month when direct flood impacts began.
condition: Record only when reported by the source.
allowed_values: Integer from 1 to 31, valid for Start year and Start month
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: Unknown day remains missing; do not impute a calendar day.

description: Year when direct flood impacts ended.
condition: Required if End month or End day is reported.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: Partial end dates are retained at the precision reported by the source.

description: Month when direct flood impacts ended.
condition: Requires End year; required if End day is reported.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: Unknown month remains missing; do not impute a calendar month.

description: Day of the month when direct flood impacts ended.
condition: Requires End year and End month.
allowed_values: Integer from 1 to 31, valid for End year and End month
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: When known, the end date must not precede the start date.

description: Affected provincial-level administrative regions in mainland China.
condition: At least one provincial-level region per record.
allowed_values: Anhui; Beijing; Chongqing; Fujian; Gansu; Guangdong; Guangxi; Guizhou; Hainan; Hebei; Heilongjiang; Henan; Hubei; Hunan; Inner Mongolia; Jiangsu; Jiangxi; Jilin; Liaoning; Ningxia; Qinghai; Shaanxi; Shandong; Shanghai; Shanxi; Sichuan; Tianjin; Xinjiang; Xizang; Yunnan; Zhejiang
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: Multiple names are separated by a comma and space. Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are outside the database scope.

description: More specific place names reported in the source, such as cities, counties, townships, villages or river basins.
condition: Record only when reported by the source.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: Retains source place-name information; not a standardized administrative-code or coordinate field.

description: Flood-related disaster category assigned to the record.
condition: Required for every record.
allowed_values: rainstorm flood; typhoon; snowmelt flood; ice-jam flood; dam-break flood
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: Values are lowercase and use the spelling shown in allowed_values.

description: Typhoon number or name associated with the event.
condition: Required when Disaster category is typhoon.
allowed_values: Free text containing a typhoon number or name
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: More than one typhoon may be named in a record. Blank for non-typhoon records.

description: Number of people killed or missing as a direct result of the flood disaster.
condition: At least one of deaths and missing persons, affected population, affected cropland area, collapsed dwellings, or current-price direct economic losses must be positive in each record.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: One of the five core impact indicators. A reported zero is distinct from an unreported value.

description: Number of people directly affected by the disaster.
condition: At least one of deaths and missing persons, affected population, affected cropland area, collapsed dwellings, or current-price direct economic losses must be positive in each record.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: One of the five core impact indicators. Multiply by 1000 to obtain persons.

description: Sown crop area with yield reduction of more than 10%.
condition: At least one of deaths and missing persons, affected population, affected cropland area, collapsed dwellings, or current-price direct economic losses must be positive in each record.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: One of the five core impact indicators. Multiply by 1000 to obtain hectares.

description: Sown crop area with yield reduction of more than 30%.
condition: Record only when reported by the source.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: A more severe cropland-impact category; do not add it to affected cropland area as an independent area. Multiply by 1000 to obtain hectares.

description: Sown crop area with yield reduction of more than 80%.
condition: Record only when reported by the source.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: A more severe cropland-impact category; do not add it to affected or damaged cropland area as an independent area. Multiply by 1000 to obtain hectares.

description: Dwelling rooms that collapsed or were severely damaged and required reconstruction.
condition: At least one of deaths and missing persons, affected population, affected cropland area, collapsed dwellings, or current-price direct economic losses must be positive in each record.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: One of the five core impact indicators. Rooms are not buildings or households. Multiply by 1000 to obtain rooms.

description: Dwelling rooms structurally damaged but repairable.
condition: Record only when reported by the source.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: Rooms are not buildings or households. Multiply by 1000 to obtain rooms.

description: Direct economic losses reported at current prices.
condition: At least one of deaths and missing persons, affected population, affected cropland area, collapsed dwellings, or current-price direct economic losses must be positive in each record.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: One of the five core impact indicators. Paired with the 2023 constant-price loss field. Multiply by 1000000 to obtain CNY.

field_name: Direct economic losses (2023 constant prices, million CNY)
description: Direct economic losses adjusted to 2023 prices using annual consumer price index (CPI) information.
condition: Required when Direct economic losses (million CNY) is reported.
missing_value: Empty CSV field or blank Excel cell; missing is not zero.
notes: Derived from current-price losses using the adjustment factor for Start year. This is a second price basis for the same loss indicator, not an additional independent impact.

description: Source document series from which the event information was obtained.
condition: At least one source name per record.
allowed_values: China Water Resources Yearbook; Yearbook of Meteorological Disasters in China; Top Ten Natural Disasters in China
missing_value: Not allowed.
notes: Multiple source names are separated by a comma and space or the enumeration comma (U+3001). Source attribution is at record level.
